movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Body Slam
movelist.effect: Body Slam Paralyzes the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Dragon Rush
movelist.effect: The target is Pushed 3 meters. Dragon Rush Flinches the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Work Up
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Slam
movelist.effect: Slam may be used as a Free Action at the end of a Sprint Maneuver taken as a Standard Action, as long as the user Shifted at least 3 meters in a straight line towards the target. When used this way, Slam gains the Smite keyword.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.effect: The Pokémon resists Ground-Type Moves one step further, and gains a Levitate Speed of 4, or has existing Levitate Speeds increased by +2. Defensive.

abilities.name: Polycephaly
abilities.effect: The user may make Struggle Attacks as a Swift Action.  Struggle Attacks made this way are resisted one step further than they normally would be.

abilities.name: Unaware
abilities.effect: Whenever the user attacks, they ignore all positive Combat Stages to the target’s Defense, Special Defense, and Speed.
